derived_from.packaging: render meshes kept, transforms baked, handle already toward +X; the delivered colliders, per-collider masses, rigid-body mass/inertia, PhysicsScene, grasp curve and root hierarchy replaced; the delivered polished-chrome looks replaced by a hammered-stainless look, the walls' st re-projected cylindrically so the finish map runs round the jug
derived_from.look: hammered stainless, UsdPreviewSurface: metallic 1, base colour (0.62, 0.62, 0.63), roughness 0.27, and a hammered-dimple normal map (procedural Worley facets, 64 per tile, about 9-14 mm across on the walls' cylindrical UVs, 1024 px, tileable); the handle the same steel, satin, roughness 0.27

asset.description: Large polished stainless serving pitcher (about 2.8 L) with a pour spout and a loop handle. Z-up, metres, base centre at the origin, handle toward +X.
asset.mass_source: model, not weighed: sheet stainless (7900 kg/m^3) laid on the render surface and integrated per triangle (mass, centre of mass and full inertia tensor): side walls 0.7 mm, an encapsulated 3.0 mm base, a rolled rim at 52 g/m (a 3 mm bead of 0.7 mm sheet), handles as hollow formed or tubular sections at 0.9 mm, mounts at 1.0 mm, a pressed foot at 0.8 mm; cross-checked against a cylinder-shell + base-disc + handle + rim hand estimate (within 5 %); the 3.0 mm base is a modelling choice (an encapsulated bottom), not taken from a product reference. The delivered CAD measures 1.5 mm at the base and 1.4-1.6 mm in the walls. The base is 0.227 kg, 27 % of the mass, and holds the centre of mass at 37 % of the height, so the tilt and drop results in newton_smoke hold because of this choice: with a 0.7 mm single-sheet base (the PR #343 review's re-run, base mass scaled by 0.7/3) the jug falls in one 20 deg tilted drop, away from the handle (toward -X), and its static tip angle drops to 16.0 deg

physics_material.source: friction as delivered (cad2sim's steel); restitution 0.1, the pool's stainless value, in place of the delivered 0.3

collision.tool: CoACD 1.0.14 on each render part (watertight as delivered), primitives where noted
collision.base_disc: one more hull, of the render vessel's points within 1.5 mm of its lowest point, so the support reaches the visible base edge (the CoACD hulls round it off ~2 mm inside)

grasp_lines.note: through the vessel axis (x = 0) at z = 0.12 m, half the pitcher's height, where the belly is 67.6 mm in radius; the loop handle on +X is left to the hand. The proposer's cylinder-diameter line ran along x through the handle and the spout
grasp_lines.evidence: hand-placed from ray-cast half-widths of the render mesh at that height (pxr + trimesh), endpoints 2 cm clear of the wall as the proposer adds them; pinned in the maintainers' grasp line overrides; not simulated

newton_smoke.engine: Newton 1.8.0.dev0 (main 9c28c80c), MuJoCo / mujoco_warp 3.15, warp 1.17; standalone, not the Arena env
newton_smoke.cases: upright 2 cm drop; 2 cm drops leaning 10 and 20 deg toward eight directions (+x is the handle side); static releases 1 mm above the plane leaning 10 and 15 deg toward the same eight; per direction, a bisection of the static-release angle (0.5 deg); a case falls when the final tilt exceeds 45 deg

handle_hook.test: capsule finger (r 7 mm) through the handle loop, prismatic lift 0.15 m in 1.5 s, hold 1 s; Newton contacts

newton_smoke.static_tip_angle_basis: geometric, base only: the centre of mass over the edge of the base colliders' support polygon (the maintainers' base_support.py), the smallest over all directions; the handle and anything else that can reach the floor is not counted, and it is not a simulated limit
newton_smoke.direction_note: all three jugs and prop_jug_1l show lower Newton-contact than MuJoCo-contact static tip angles toward the -X diagonals on Newton main (prop_jug_1l 24.8 against 30.1 deg); ikea_idealisk_jug_1l shows it toward +X-Y (29.4 against 34.3 deg); tracked in #351
newton_smoke.controls: ikea_idealisk_jug_1l and prop_jug_1l under the same harness on Newton main: 0 falls in either contact mode

handle_hook.test: capsule finger (r 7 mm) through the handle loop, prismatic lift 0.15 m in 1.5 s, hold 1 s; Newton contacts
